run_mine_bitexts: run the mine function to extract bitext alignments from forward and backward distance and index files
build_neighbors_from_indices: build neighbor objects from FAISS index files and distance arrays using margin-based scoring
run_fastmax_retrieval: run fastmax retrieval to filter forward and backward neighbor candidates above a score threshold
run_blended_retrieval: run blended retrieval combining margin scores with auxiliary embeddings using a comparator model
read_array_metadata: read numpy array metadata from a shard file to get element count and dtype
